name: AusIMM Student membership
provider: Australasian Institute of Mining and Metallurgy
summary: Free annual student membership of AusIMM for full-time students heading into mining, metallurgy and the resources sector.
key: Student Membership is a FREE annual membership, with a one-off $22 application fee.
